name: @saltix/connect
description: Sign in with Saltix on a website or DApp: the page's side of Saltix Connect, its button and dialog, and the server's side for a session the server holds (Saltix 19-connect, docs/protocol/connect.md)

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp src/connect.css dist/connect.css && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --log-level=warning --outfile=dist/saltix-connect.js
